workarounds.symptom: Per-record tool-use stats in the Records, Leaderboard and Trends tabs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Add per-record tool-use statistics. Target files: src/core/trulens/core/database/base.py, src/core/trulens/core/database/connector/base.py, src/core/trulens/core/database/sqlalchemy.py. Adds deterministic per-record tool-use statistics computed from stored OpenTelemetry spans, making tool behavior available without requiring an LLM judge. (Ref: https://github.com/truera/trulens/pull/2992)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Feedback callback failures are logged** — `run_and_call_callback` returned from a `finally` block, discarding any exception the `on_done` callback raised, including a failed `add_feedback` write. Failures are now logged, and `KeyboardInterrupt` and other `BaseException`s are no longer swallowed. (#2819) by @YHC66. Upstream PR #2819. (Ref: https://github.com/truera/trulens/pull/2819)

workarounds.symptom: trulens trulens-2.15.0: **The trace reaches HTTP/protobuf-only backends.** `otel_exporter="otlp"` only ever built gRPC exporters, so an HTTP/protobuf-only OTLP endpoint failed with a missing-dependency `I
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **The trace reaches HTTP/protobuf-only backends.** `otel_exporter="otlp"` only ever built gRPC exporters, so an HTTP/protobuf-only OTLP endpoint failed with a missing-dependency `ImportError`. `TruSession` now takes `otlp_protocol` (`"grpc"` or `"http/protobuf"`), honors `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL` and `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL`, and still defaults to gRPC. Client hooks gain the matching `TRULENS_OTLP_PROTOCOL` variable and a new `TRULENS_DESTINATION=ai_gateway` for Snowflake Cortex AI Gateways, which serve OTLP over HTTP/protobuf only; `make_ai_gateway_otel_exporter()` in `trulens.connectors.snowflake.otel_exporter` builds the same exporter for connector users. Hook export failures are now logged with turn, client, and conversation context instead of being swallowed by the journal worker. (#2785) by @sfc-gh-jreini. Upstream PR #2785. (Ref: https://github.com/truera/trulens/pull/2785)

workarounds.symptom: trulens trulens-2.15.0: **Pre-OTel leaderboard no longer crashes** — `get_leaderboard_aggregates()` raised `NotImplementedError` whenever OTEL tracing was disabled, because the SQL used JSON subscripts on
workarounds.workaround: Fix: **Pre-OTel leaderboard no longer crashes** — `get_leaderboard_aggregates()` raised `NotImplementedError` whenever OTEL tracing was disabled, because the SQL used JSON subscripts on `TEXT` columns and referenced a nonexistent `Record.latency` column. Aggregation now happens in Python using the existing extraction helpers. (#2730) by @Aftabbs. Upstream PR #2730. (Ref: https://github.com/truera/trulens/pull/2730)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: **`TP.submit` restored** — #2393 removed `TP.submit` without updating its callers, so feedback scheduling raised `AttributeError` and feedback functions could not be scheduled at all. (#2806) by @YHC66. Upstream PR #2393. (Ref: https://github.com/truera/trulens/pull/2393)
